about: Which release rows a candidate runs (Dom 2026-10-05: get the 50 checks down to 5; Lead 2026-10-22: delta rows only, cut-to-live <= 25 min). core runs for any change outside docs; areas add the rows of the files a diff touches; a row whose own check script changed runs; full paths run every row. Every other row is out of scope: it was green in the last full run. Read by scripts/release-rows-for.mjs (deployRowsFor), which release-checks.yml and deploy.sh both call. A row is named by its check script's stem; name:first / name:last = only the first / last row with that name.

full_why: the build: a change here can break any row (Auditor B1 on #1381). public/** outside public_scoped is also a full run (GLBs and looks many rows load).
lib_no_rows_why: scripts/lib files no release row imports (the deploy pipeline's own; their unit tests cover them). A lib listed nowhere stays a full run (Strategy 2026-10-10: Z cost 52 rows for data-only.mjs).
